text:
deploybot: Scheduled rollout for tenant 'Orbis' slice-C on Dedicated pool. Rollout ID rb-88123. Cutover window 2025-07-03 02:00 UTC -> 02:40 UTC. Please ack readiness and call out blockers.

evan: Quick Q — KMS rotation ticket? I saw a rotation scheduled 02:10 UTC in ops-calendar: https://redwood.co/tickets/PROJ-987 Will that collide?

anika: @evan we removed KMS rotation from that slot. Rotation moved to 04:00 UTC. Infra team confirmed KMS keys will be stable during the window.

leo: Are we pinning runtime/model versions for this tenant? Need explicit versioning to ensure deterministic behavior during rollback.

anika: Yes. We'll pin runtime image rwd-infer:2.4.1-rc3 on the dedicated pool. Fallback pinned to rwd-infer:2.3.9. Cache warmup TTL set to 120s.

evan: Rollback thresholds proposal: abort and roll back if error rate > 5% sustained for 3 consecutive minutes OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 2 consecutive mins. Also auto-hold traffic on anomalies.

leo: @sre_oncall can you own monitoring during the first 60m? Need p50/p95/p99, 5xx alert, and token-cost delta alert.

sre_oncall: I'm on watch. Will enable extra retention for logs (48h) and turn on verbose tracing for the slice. Alerts: p95>2x, 5xx>1% will page. Also will keep the incident channel open.

deploybot: Canary plan: slice-C canary 02:00-02:20 (5% traffic), ramp to 25% at 02:20, 50% at 02:30, 100% by 02:40. Automated hold if any threshold breached.

anika: infra + ops acked. :thumbsup:

evan: product acked. No data migrations scheduled this window.

leo: eng-release acked. Confirming no other rollouts overlapping.

sre_oncall: acked. I'll escalate to oncall lead if we hit thresholds.

deploybot: Rollout marked GO. Abort command (if needed):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/deploys/rb-88123/abort -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN"
```

anika: Leaving post-rollout note: if we hit minor regressions, prefer immediate traffic hold + 30m investigation before full rollback.

leo: All set. Thanks team.
